title: Context-heavy bounded responsibility task kill sweep
purpose: Test whether bounded low-permission responsibility tasks resist micro-unit commoditization because each transaction requires context acquisition, judgment or local interpretation. Retain only a named current Xuzhou/Jiangsu manual workaround that survives mature vertical service routes.
scan_rule: A vertical provider can standardize context through intake schemas, checklists, measurement protocols, acceptance criteria and reports.
Do not reopen generic local field-evidence crowdsourcing already closed in Scan 006.

patterns_tested.incumbent_evidence: Current inspection platforms already sell simple supplier/factory audits as bounded services with standardized reports at roughly hundreds of RMB per visit in some offerings.
Current Jiangsu inspection providers already productize pre-shipment inspection, loading supervision, factory assessment and report delivery across many product categories.

incumbent_evidence: Current Xuzhou door/window suppliers bundle free measurement, design, delivery, installation and after-sales.
National custom-home service networks already route measurement, installation, repair and delivery with platform guarantees.

patterns_tested.incumbent_evidence: Current Xuzhou-facing third-party service pages already sell bounded on-site waterproof acceptance with inspection records at around RMB 200 starting reference price.

Current third-party inspection providers already encode those transaction-specific variables into standardized condition reports for used equipment procurement, resale, relocation, insurance and acceptance.
Current national home-service platforms expose millions of service nodes and route measurement, installation, repair, dismantling and delivery with platform guarantee, replacement and after-sales.

patterns_tested.pattern: small Xuzhou private buyer still self-assessing because context service is uneconomic

material_learning: Context acquisition and local judgment do not prevent commoditization when a vertical can define the relevant variables and acceptance schema.
The market repeatedly transforms contextual work into bounded audits, surveys, measurement tasks, inspection checklists and reports.
No named current Xuzhou/Jiangsu actor remained in a measurable manual workaround after these vertical services were considered.
Further abstract mechanism scans risk looping; the next search should return to concrete current private-market events and bind buyer-side cost before mechanism labeling.
cross_industry_result.current_best_next_truth: Fresh Scan 024 should return to broad current Xuzhou/Jiangsu private-market events but impose a buyer-cost-first rule: retain no pattern until one named private actor is observed paying, waiting, rerouting, losing output or repeatedly using a workaround. Only after binding that event should the engine classify the mechanism and search incumbents.
